content: {"rule":"RESULT","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text announces DEFENDER WINS and recites CHALLENGE STANDING and collision grades, so the RESULT rule governs it.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"CHALLENGE STANDING: PROP-DEPENDENT -- L=6 c=0 -- The challenger cannot be self-supported because link C3 was broken at collision against explicit conception bounds.","rule_words":"HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN.","room":"not SELF-SUPPORTED — either the judge's 'cannot be self-supported' satisfies it, or only an exact 'not SELF-SUPPORTED' label would.","why":"Because the judge states that the challenger cannot be self-supported, the defender-win result satisfies the rule's condition even though the separate BROKEN grade is later retracted."}
